newsitem.title: USA: TVA Browns Ferry power plant back at full output.
newsitem.headline: TVA Browns Ferry power plant back at full output.

text.p: TVA Nuclear's 1,065 megawatt Browns Ferry nuclear power unit 2 returned to full output from a repair outage which began in late October, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The Decatur, Ala. unit was operating at 100 percent by early Tuesday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The unit tripped off line Oct 29 after a problem with a generator backup relay.
The nearby 1,065 megawatt Browns Ferry nuclear unit 3 continued to operate at full power as of Tuesday morning, the NRC said.
TVA Nuclear is a unit of the federal Tennessee Valley Authority.
